The '''Rurgavea system''' was located within the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the origin point of the [[Rurgavean Sleight]] military tactic.<ref name="DNII">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Rurgavean Sleight]]|system=Rurgavea [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Rurgavea system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
